data.reimport_days: Re-import the last N days on every run

data_description.include_provisional: The portal fills the current day with estimates (state 'v') until the gateway has transmitted, usually the next day. Off: wait for measured values. On: import the estimates right away; the re-import below corrects them later.
data_description.reimport_days: Fetch these days again on every run so corrections by the portal end up in the statistics. 0 disables it.
